claims: The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball First Four was played March 17-18 at UD Arena in Dayton, Ohio.
Texas defeated NC State 68-66 on March 17.
No. 16 Prairie View A&M vs. No. 16 Lehigh on March 18 at 6:40 p.m. ET on truTV.
No. 11 Miami (Ohio) vs. No. 11 SMU on March 18 at 9:15 p.m. ET on truTV.
Nebraska vs. Richmond on March 18 in the 2026 Women's First Four.
Missouri State vs. Stephen F. Austin on March 18 in the 2026 Women's First Four.
Southern vs. Samford on March 19 in the 2026 Women's First Four.
Virginia vs. Arizona State on March 19 in the 2026 Women's First Four.
All games are held at the University of Dayton Arena in Dayton, Ohio.
The First Four consists of the four lowest-ranked conference champions (No. 16 seeds) and the four lowest-ranked "at-large" teams (often No. 11 seeds).
Winners move on to the first round of the NCAA Tournament.
The first round of the NCAA Tournament is officially known as the Round of 64.
